Shipping & Payment Terms

At Bullion Portfolio Trading LLC, we offer maximum flexibility and security for the receipt of your precious metals. You can choose between personal collection (see Section 2) and insured delivery to your preferred address within the city of Dubai (see Section 3). Depending on the option chosen, we charge either a flat-rate preparation fee for collection or a flat-rate for insured delivery. To ensure the highest level of security and discretion for your precious metal purchases, our deliveries are subject to strict security guidelines and geographical restrictions.

Please also note our payment terms (see Section 1), which provide exclusively for payment in advance (bank transfer).

  1. Payment Terms, Price Fixing & Compliance

To ensure the security of your transaction and compliance with legal regulations in the precious metals trade, the following binding payment and compliance rules apply to all orders:

  • Binding Price Fixing: Since the price of precious metals depends on current fluctuations in the financial markets, the final price is bindingly fixed at the time of your order. Subsequent withdrawal, cancellation, or return due to a “change of mind” is therefore excluded according to our precious metal trading guidelines. All sales are final.
  • Maturity & Payment Method: Payment is due immediately upon conclusion of the contract. We work exclusively on a pre-payment basis via bank transfer. Other payment methods are not offered.
  • Bank Details for your Transfer: Please always state your order number as the reference to ensure quick allocation. Please use the following account details for the payment of your invoice:
    • Account Holder: BULLION PORTFOLIO TRADING LLC
    • Bank Name: Mashreq Bank PSC
    • IBAN: AE30 0330 0000 1910 1910 273
    • SWIFT / BIC: BOMLAEAD
    • Currency: AED
    • Reference: Order #[order number]

Important Note on Transfer Fees: Please ensure that the invoice amount is received in full and without deductions in our account. We recommend the fee option “OUR” (sender bears all costs). Should the payment received differ from the invoice amount due to bank fees or exchange rate differences, the difference will be charged separately and must be settled before the goods are delivered.

  • Exclusion of Cash Payments: To ensure maximum transparency and security in accordance with regulatory requirements in Dubai, we categorically do not accept cash payments.
  • Prohibition of Third-Party Payments & Compliance Check: We only accept payments from bank accounts held in the name of the buyer specified in the purchase contract. Should a payment be received from a third-party account, it will not be accepted as fulfillment of the contract. In the case of a third-party payment, we reserve the right to block the transaction internally and involve our compliance department. Any reversal, minus incurred bank fees, will be made exclusively to the source account and only after a successful identity check of the depositor (KYC) to exclude money laundering risks. We point out that in the case of unclear payment flows, we may be legally obliged to submit a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) via the goAML portal to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) of the UAE. In such a case, the transaction may not be reversed until cleared by the authorities.
  • Retention of Title: The delivered goods remain our property until full payment of all claims against the buyer.
  • Compliance & Source of Funds: For orders with a value of 55,000 AED (or equivalent) or more, we are obliged under UAE Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations to request proof of the legal Source of Funds. Delivery will only take place after successful verification of these documents by our compliance department.
  1. Self-Collection at Loomis (Gold Souk)

If you wish to receive your goods in person, we will store them in the high-security vault of our logistics partner Loomis International at the Gold Souk in Dubai.

Address for Collection: Loomis International, AE

Gold Land building, 1st floor Office number 128

Gold Souk Deira Dubai, United Arab Emirates

P.O. Box 371010

As soon as your goods have been prepared for collection, you will be informed via email. Collection is possible from Monday to Saturday between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM following successful notification.

In this case, only the Window Collection Fees (preparation fees) apply:

  • Total weight up to 5 kg: 179 AED*
  • Total weight up to 20 kg: 253 AED*
  • Total weight up to 50 kg: 327 AED*
  • Total weight up to 100 kg: 474 AED*
  • For collections over 100 kg: Please contact us via email(sales@bpt-shop.ae) or WhatApp (+971 58 599 8412) for individual arrangements.

* All fees mentioned above are subject to an additional 5% Value Added Tax (VAT).

Important Note on Procedure: The entire coordination, notification, and billing of the incurred fees are handled directly through us (Bullion Portfolio Trading LLC). Please only proceed to the vault at the Gold Souk after you have received confirmation from us that your goods are ready for handover.

  1. Insured Delivery to your Address within Dubai City

For convenient and fully insured delivery directly to your address within the city limits of Dubai, we charge a weight-based delivery flat rate. With this option, the Window Collection Fees are waived.

  • Total weight up to 50 kg: 359 AED*
  • Total weight 50 kg bis 100 kg: 536 AED*
  • For collections over 100 kg: Please contact us via email(sales@bpt-shop.ae) or WhatApp (+971 58 599 8412) for individual arrangements.

* All fees mentioned above are subject to an additional 5% Value Added Tax (VAT).

Important Requirements for all Shipping Methods, Logistics Partners & Security

Shipping and issuance of goods are carried out via highly specialized value logistics partners such as Loomis International.

  • Identity Verification (KYC): The presentation of a valid Emirates ID is mandatory for both collection and delivery. The handover of the goods takes place exclusively upon presentation of a valid identification document (Emirates ID). The identity of the recipient must strictly match the data on their Emirates ID, the name on the purchase order/order confirmation, and the bank account used for payment.
  • Personal Handover: The goods will be handed over exclusively to the buyer in person against a signature. Delivery to third parties, packing stations, P.O. boxes, or unguarded drop-off locations is categorically excluded. A physical confirmation of receipt is required.
  • Insurance Coverage: Every shipment is insured through our logistics partner against loss and theft up to a goods value of 15 million USD.
  • Geographical Focus: Please note that we currently deliver our goods exclusively within the city limits of Dubai (UAE). Deliveries to other Emirates or abroad can be requested individually. Please contact us via email (sales@bpt-shop.ae) or WhatsApp (+971 58 599 8412) to request individual processing.

Important Notes on Acceptance

  • Duty to Inspect: Please check the shipment immediately upon handover for intactness and the integrity of the seals. Any damage must be noted immediately on the confirmation of receipt.
  • Reporting Deadline: Hidden damages must be reported within 48 hours (2 calendar days) via our online complaint form (LINK).
  • Unsuccessful Delivery / Default of Acceptance: Should a delivery fail (e.g., due to absence or refusal of identity verification), the goods will be returned to the high-security vault. The resulting return transport and storage costs shall be borne by the customer. A new delivery will only take place after full settlement of these fees as well as the costs for the new delivery attempt by the customer.

Further details can be found in our General Terms and Conditions and our AML & KYC Policy.
